from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-60daa7a9.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] != background:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            components.append(cells)
    source = next(cells for cells in components if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r,c in cells))
    target = next(cells for cells in components if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r,c in cells))
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in source), max(r for r,c in source)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in source), max(c for r,c in source)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r,c in target), max(r for r,c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r,c in target), max(c for r,c in target)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(tr0, tr1+1):
        for c in range(tc0, tc1+1):
            sr = r0 + (r-tr0)
            sc = c1 - (c-tc0)
            out[r][c] = grid[sr][sc]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
